mentions.name: ssa
mentions.description: An AI agent designed to feel like a unix utility, capable of writing and editing files; recent work changed how it handles file writes and edits.
mentions.source_excerpt: I worked on my AI agent that feels like a unix util. This month I changed the way it writes and edits files
mentions.author: pianopatrick

mentions.name: ssa
mentions.description: A single-file AI agent written in POSIX sh. It can be used by downloading the file, marking it executable, and setting up environment variables.
mentions.source_excerpt: I rewrote my AI agent written in POSIX sh to be a single file. So now to use it all you have to do is download the file, mark it executable, and set up environment variables.
mentions.author: pianopatrick

mentions.name: ssa
mentions.description: An AI agent written in POSIX shell, useful for debugging command line problems on Linux, such as fixing apt problems.
mentions.source_excerpt: This month I worked on my own AI agent written in POSIX shell. It's been surprisingly useful for debugging command line problems on an old laptop running linux, like fixing an apt problem.
mentions.author: pianopatrick
